testo:
■ If you have the Light, Fire and Nature civilizations in your mana zone, you may pay Costicon to summon this creature.
■ Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your light, fire or nature creatures.
■ Your "Dedede Danger Dash" costs 2 less. They can't cost less than 1.
